parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

activities.description: The activities associated with the candidate.

anonymized.description: The date when the candidate was anonymized. Remarks: Can be null if the candidate was not anonymized yet.

archived.description: Determines if the candidate is archived.

betterThan.description: The percentage of candidates that the current candidate outperforms. Remarks: If null , the candidate didn't finish the test yet.

certificate.description: The certificate associated with the candidate. Remarks: This can be null if the candidate doesn't have a certificate.

deadline.description: The deadline for the candidate to take the test. Remarks: Can be null if the candidate does not have a set deadline.

maxScore.description: The potential max score of the candidate. Remarks: It will only have a value if it's not equal CandidateModel.Score .

needsScoring.description: Determines if the candidate has answers that need to be manually scored.

notes.description: The notes associated with the candidate.

passed.description: Determines if the candidate has passed the test. Remarks: Always false if candidate has not finished the test yet. This property depends on the cutoff score and can also be overridden per candidate. Before using this property, check CandidateModel.PassedOverride . If that is null , the value of this property prevails.

passedOverride.description: Overrides the value of CandidateModel.Passed . Remarks: If it's null , no override has been applied and that value must be considered (ignoring this one).

possibleCheating.description: Determines if the candidate possibly cheated on its test.

possibleCheatingAttempts.description: The possible cheating attempts of the candidate.

proctoringEnabled.description: Determines if proctoring is enabled for the candidate.

proctoringStatus.description: The proctoring status of the candidate.

questions.description: The questions and answers associated with the candidate.

score.description: The score of the candidate. Remarks: If null , the candidate didn't finish the test yet.

shouldNotify.description: Determines if the candidate should be notified via email about its result in the test.

skillScores.description: The scores per skill of the candidate.

tags.description: The tags associated with the candidate.

test.description: The test that the candidate is invited to.

testUrl.description: The details of the Test URL used to invite the candidate. Remarks: It will be null if the candidate was not invited via a Test URL (invited via URL).

timeTaken.description: The time (in seconds) the candidate took to finish the test. Remarks: This is 0 if the candidate didn't finish the test yet.

get.description: Retrieves the current plan from TestDome.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

canCloneQuestions.description: If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `true`, this account can clone questions. If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `false`, the PlanAuthorizationModel.ErrorMessage property will be filled with information of why the authorization failed.

canCreateTest.description: If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `true`, the plan allows the user to create tests. If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `false`, the PlanAuthorizationModel.ErrorMessage property will be filled with information of why the authorization failed.

isPaymentSubscriptionActive.description: Indicates if the plan has an active payment method set up.

isSubscription.description: Indicates if the plan is a recurring subscription.

isTrial.description: Indicates if the plan is a trial.

questionsToCloneAvailable.description: The remaining number of questions that can be cloned this month.

supportsPremiumFeatures.description: If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `true`, this account supports premium features. This flag does not indicate if the plan is paid. If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `false`, the PlanAuthorizationModel.ErrorMessage property will be filled with information of why the authorization failed. For example, it can be a trial plan, which is not paid but allows users to see premium questions and take advantage of other premium features.

supportsSso.description: If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `true`, this account supports SSO. If PlanAuthorizationModel.Authorized = `false`, the PlanAuthorizationModel.ErrorMessage property will be filled with information of why the authorization failed.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

affectedByNextDeprecation.description: Indicates if the test is affected by the next question deprecation wave.

archived.description: The flag to describe if the test is archived.

candidatesCount.description: The total of candidates in this test.

cutoffScore.description: Minimum score for a candidate to be considered approved. Range is [0, 100].

daysUntilNextDeprecation.description: Indicates how many days until the next question deprecation wave. Note that this test will only be affected if TestModel.AffectedByNextDeprecation is `true`.

expectedPassRate.description: The percentage of candidates expected to pass this test considering the current questions.

inviteViaEmailParameters.description: The last parameters used to invite a candidate via email in this test.

needsScoring.description: Returns the number of candidates that need scoring. If null, the test does not have manually scored questions.

notifyCandidatesParameters.description: The last parameters used to notify candidate's passing status via email in this test.

notifyTo.description: Defines the email addresses of those that will be notified when a candidate finishes this test.

proctoringConsent.description: Indicates if the consent to enable proctoring was provided. Remarks: The value can be: - true : the consent request was given and it shouldn't be requested on the next invitation. - false : the consent request wasn't given or was denied and it should be requested on the next invitation.

questions.description: The questions that make up this test.

questionsCount.description: The total of questions in this test.

scheduledCandidatesCount.description: The total of scheduled candidates in this test.

skills.description: The skills of the questions of this test.

testUrls.description: The URLs used to share this test.

testUrlStatus.description: The status of the test URL(s) in this test. none: Test has no URL(s) created. on: Test has URL(s) available for candidates to take the test. off: Test has URL(s) created but none is available for candidates to take the test.

timeLimit.description: The time limit of all the questions in this test.

urlSettings.description: The URL settings of this test.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

databaseOptions.description: If the test contains multi-sql questions, this setting defines databases that can be used by the candidate.

integrationDeadlineInDays.description: Gets or sets the deadline in days for candidates invited through integration.

integrationProctoring.description: Gets or sets whether invites would have Proctoring enabled for candidates invited through integration.

isAiForbidden.description: Gets or sets whether AI tools are forbidden for candidates taking this test.

notifyTo.description: Defines the email addresses of those that will be notified when a candidate finishes this test.

showFinalScoreToCandidate.description: Defines if candidates are able to see their score when they finish the test.

timingPolicy.description: Defines the timing policy of the test, to decide how strict is the time limit enforcement. strict: Candidates will have the exact amount of time defined by the question. normal: Candidates will have the amount of time with an extra 50% buffer. relaxed: Candidates will have the amount of time with an extra 200% buffer.
